senses.gloss: (perh. fr. r. כלז, cmp. Arab. ḳalaza, collegit, a. כרז, קלס; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. כרשׂ; var. forms: אָכְלוֹזָא, אוֹכְלוֹסָא, אוֹכְלָסָא, כְּלוֹזָא; h. form only in pl. אוֹכְלוֹסִין, const. אוֹכְלוֹסֵי, אוֹכְלָסִין) levy of troops or forced laborers (corresp. to h. צָבָא).
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:6">Targ. I Chr. XI, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:1">XX, 1</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 8a">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:5">B. Mets. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>נפקי בא׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="K00698"><he>כלוזא</he></cite>) they have to go out themselves to do public labors (not permitted to hire substitutes).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>לאו בני א׳ וכ׳</he> are exempt from the levy.

<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:2">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 76b">Yeb. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>יצא בא׳</he> went out with the army; [strike out <he>ודרש בא׳</he> Ber. l. c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40]; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אוֹכְלוֹזִין</he>, <he>אוֹכְלוֹסִין</he>, <he>אוֹכְלָסִין</he> (v. supra).
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 12:22">Targ. I Chr. XII, 22</cite>; a. fr.—Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 2 <he>אוכלסין</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:3">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite>; <he>אוֹכְלוֹסֵי ישראל</he> a Jewish army. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ top.; Y. Snh. X, 29ᵇ top. … <he>אוֹכלוֹסַיָּיא ד</he> the armies of students; a. fr.—Cmp. <cite ref="A01707"><he>אָכְלוֹשֵׁי</he></cite>. [Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵃ; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02450"><he>אִסְכּוֹלִי</he></cite>].
